Description: Global upper limit for the maximum capacity of each extendable DC link.
Global lower limit for the maximum capacity of each extendable DC link.
Specifies how to handle lines which are currently under construction. 'zero': set capacity to zero; 'remove': remove completely, 'keep': keep with full capacity.

Values: false or path to a csv
Description: Rated capacity of one HVDC line (a bipole) per country and pole voltage (columns ``country``, ``voltage_kv``, ``p_nom_mw``; country ``*`` = default). A line takes its country's row within 10 % of its voltage, otherwise the nearest default row; converters take the summed rating of the DC links at their DC bus. ``false``: ``p_nom`` = ``v_nom`` times the current of the ``lines: dc_types`` cable type.
